notes: Missing numbers now fill themselves in: pressing Scan automatically examines any item whose effects still show a bare "+" with no value (the game only sends the rolled number when that specific item is examined). No more hovering each item by hand — the scan selects and examines them for you, one at a time, then puts your original target back. Items examined once are remembered permanently, so this normally only happens on a first scan. Also fixed a weapon with "+(W) damage" being flagged as missing a number forever, and guarded the remembered-item store against the client occasionally reporting your character name as a number.
